freeModeDescription: Free play mode. Toggle any settings, use any helpers, save your progression, etc.

giveUpDialog.description: Are you sure you want to give up?
giveUpDialog.title: Give Up?

challengeMode.description: Test your skills! In Challenge Mode, all settings are locked at the start. You can customize which helpers are available, but once the game starts, no changes allowed. Race against time to complete the quiz as fast as possible!
challengeMode.title: Challenge Mode

gameModes.description: Choose how you want to play! Select from Regional quizzes (like Kanto or Johto), Type-based quizzes (all Water or Fire Pokémon), Special quizzes (like Legendary or Mega Pokémon) or tackle the Full National Dex. Each mode offers a unique challenge.

freeMode.description: Play at your own pace! Free Mode lets you toggle helpers, adjust settings, save your progress, and take breaks anytime. Perfect for casual play or learning all the Pokémon names.
freeMode.title: Free Mode

limitedTime.description: Race against the clock! In Limited Time Mode, you have a set time limit to name as many Pokémon as possible. The timer counts down, and you must be quick to maximize your score!
limitedTime.title: Limited Time Mode

orderModes.description: Increase the challenge by enforcing a specific order or by removing predefined placements. Choose from Normal Mode, Dex Order, or Chaos Mode to test your Pokémon knowledge in different ways!
orderModes.title: Order Modes

listItems.normal: Normal Mode: Guess Pokémon in any order with Pokemon showing in the place according to their National Pokédex number
listItems.dex: Dex Order: Guess Pokémon in National Pokédex number order
listItems.chaos: Chaos Mode: Guess Pokémon in any order, and Pokémon will show up as you find them, without predefined placements

quizTypes.description: Select the type of quiz you want to play! You can focus on specific regions, Pokémon types, or go for the full National Dex. Each quiz type offers a different challenge!
quizTypes.title: Quiz Types

listItems.gen: Generation Quiz: Guess Pokémon from one or more generations (e.g., Gen 1, Gen 2, Gen 3)
listItems.type: Type Quiz: Guess Pokémon from specific types (e.g., Water, Fire, Psychic)
listItems.full: Full Quiz: All Pokémon from all generations, DLC included
listItems.mega: Mega Quiz: Mega Evolutions and Gigantamax only
listItems.special: Special Quiz: Legendary, Sub-Legendary, Mythical, Ultra Beasts and Paradox only

gameModes.title: Game Modes

cries.description: Hear Pokémon cries to help identify them! Press the <kbd>.</kbd> (or double-tap on mobile) to play the cry of a random missing Pokémon. Great for audio learners!
cries.title: Cries Helper

helpers.description: Stuck? Use these helpers to get hints! Each helper provides a different type of clue to help you remember Pokémon names.

shadows.description: Reveal the silhouette of Pokémon you haven't found yet. Press the <kbd>,</kbd> hotkey (or triple-tap on mobile) to reveal one random shadow. Note: Using shadows affects your leaderboard score!
shadows.title: Shadow Helper

spelling.description: Not sure about spelling? Enable Spelling Help to see suggestions as you type. The game will show the closest matching Pokémon names in real-time.
spelling.title: Spelling Help

skip.description:
Stuck on a Pokémon? Use the Skip button to reshuffle the current Type and Box. (only works in Shuffle Mode)
Note: Skips are limited! You can get new skips every 150 points, so use them wisely!
skip.title: Skip and Reshuffle

helpers.title: Helpers & Hints

howToPlay.description: The goal is to name all Pokémon in the selected set. You can choose from different game modes, quiz types, and helpers to customize your experience. Type Pokémon names and watch them appear on the grid as you find them!

scoring.description: The game uses a scoring system based on a combo-like multiplier. When you find a Pokémon, you get 1 point. Then, the next Pokémon you find will give you an additional bonus depending on the time it took to name it. Try to find Pokémon as fast as possible to maximize your score!
scoring.title: Scoring System

howToPlay.title: How to Play

typing.description: Simply start typing anywhere in the screen and try to complete the Pokémon names. The game accepts Pokémon names in multiple languages (if enabled in settings). Correct answers will appear on the grid with their sprite!
typing.title: Entering Names

leaderboards.description: Compete with players worldwide! Leaderboards track the top scores for each game mode and quiz type. Your best runs are saved and you can see how you rank against others. Scores consider completion time, score and number of shadows used.
leaderboards.title: Leaderboards

pokemonDetails.description: Click on a Pokémon to view its details! You can see its type, abilities, base stats, and more. This is a great way to learn more about the Pokémon you are guessing.
pokemonDetails.title: Pokémon Details

cloudSync.description: Sign in to sync your progress across devices! Your game state, settings, and best scores are saved to the cloud automatically. Play on your phone, continue on your computer!
cloudSync.title: Cloud Sync

saveLoad.description: Never lose your progress! Save and load your game state locally or sync to the cloud.

localSave.description: Save your current game to a file on your device, or load a previously saved game. Great for backing up your progress or trying different strategies!
localSave.title: Local Save/Load

saveLoad.title: Saving & Loading

settings.description: Customize your quiz experience! Adjust visual settings, gameplay options, and language preferences.

gameplay.description: Customize your gameplay experience with various options. Enable or disable features like Shiny Charm, Auto Pause, Auto Scroll, Sounds, and automatic cycling of sprites, regions, and types to suit your play style.
gameplay.title: Gameplay Settings

listItems.shinyCharm: Shiny Charm: Increase the chance of finding shiny Pokémon
listItems.autoPause: Auto Pause: Automatically pause the game when switching tabs or switching to a different app
listItems.sync: Sync: Automatically sync your game state to the cloud
listItems.autoScroll: Auto Scroll: Automatically scroll to newly found Pokémon
listItems.cycleSprites: Cycle Sprites: Cycle sprites of Pokemon having multiple forms (e.g. Arceus forms, Alcremie forms, etc.)
listItems.cycleRegions: Cycle Regions: In multiple region quizzes, automatically cycle through the selected regions in the app title and in the guessing input.
listItems.cycleTypes: Cycle Types: In multiple type quizzes, automatically cycle through the selected types in the app title and in the current theme and background colors

languages.description: Enable multiple languages to guess Pokémon names in English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more! You can answer in any enabled language.
languages.title: Language Options

settings.title: Settings

visual.description: Customize the visual aspects of the game.
visual.title: Visual Settings

listItems.themeColor: Theme Color: Choose your favorite color theme
listItems.language: Language: Select the language of the game
listItems.darkMode: Dark Mode: Toggle dark mode for comfortable night play

shortcuts.description: If you're stuck, the game provides you with several helpers to assist you in your naming quest. Once you toggle the helper, you can trigger the help anytime you want via keyboard shortcuts or mobile gestures. Try to guess without them!

keyboard.description: Press specific keys on the keyboard to trigger the helpers.
keyboard.title: Keyboard Shortcuts

listItems.shadow: Shadow Helper: press , to reveal a random shadow
listItems.cries: Cries Helper: press . to hear a random Pokémon cry

mobile.description: On mobile devices, you can use taps to trigger the helpers.
mobile.title: Mobile Gestures

listItems.shadow: Shadow Helper: triple-tap anywhere to reveal a random shadow
listItems.cries: Cries Helper: double-tap anywhere to hear a random Pokémon cry

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts & Hotkeys

boxShuffle.description:
Limit your guess to Pokémon from a specific box! At every answer, a random box is selected amongst the remaining Pokémon, and you must guess a Pokémon from that box.
Note: This mode cannot be enabled in a Special Quiz.
boxShuffle.title: Box Shuffle

shuffleModes.description: Add extra challenge with shuffle modes by limiting your guess to specific criteria. This adds a fun twist to the quiz, testing your knowledge of Pokémon in different ways!
shuffleModes.title: Shuffle Modes

typeShuffle.description:
Guess Pokémon by Type! At every answer, a random type is selected amongst the remaining Pokémon, and you must guess a Pokémon of that type. This mode adds a fun twist to the quiz, testing your knowledge of Pokémon types!
Note: This mode cannot be enabled in a Types Quiz.
typeShuffle.title: Type Shuffle

userProfile.description: Track your progress and achievements! View your best runs, wins breakdown, and other stats. You can also manage your nickname and see how you rank on the leaderboards.
userProfile.title: User Profile

leaderboards.name: Name
leaderboards.noRecords: No records yet. Be the first!
